versions.text: Criterion: Verify the jettisoning of fuel through an aerial refueling system meets the fuel jettisoning requirements of 8.3 and 8.4 (this document). Standard: See 8.3 and 8.4 (this document). Method of Compliance: See 8.3 and 8.4 (this document) for fuel jettisoning and fire hazards. References: JSSG-2009: G.3.4.7.2, G.4.4.7.2; G.3.4.7.3, G.4.4.7.3 MIL-HDBK-516: 8.3, 8.4
